{#- Consolidated item-wise discount (MoM 2.3). Computed from the rows on every render rather than read from the stored custom_total_line_item_discount, so documents submitted before that field existed still print a correct total. Order matters and is not cosmetic: doc.total is ALREADY net of the item discounts, so listing the discount under it would read as a second deduction and the column would not add up. Gross is shown first, the discount comes off it, and Total is the result -- three numbers a customer can check. -#} {%- set item_discount = yht_discount_total(doc) -%} {#- Strictly greater than zero. A line priced ABOVE the list rate makes the total negative -- a markup, not a discount -- and printing that as "Item Discount -(-512.16)" is worse than not printing it. Measured: sales order KSSO-26-0622 on this site does exactly that. The stored field keeps the signed figure, because a report should still be able to see it. -#} {%- if item_discount > 0 %} {%- endif %} {%- if doc.discount_amount %} {%- endif %} {%- for tax in doc.taxes %} {%- endfor %}
